node.statement: Transfer to the Euclidean norm: at level n=1, def-canonical-corner-identifications gives J_{P,Q,1}(Z)c=Zc, so the target operator norm induced by def-ha-map is ||J_{P,Q,1}(Z)||=||Z||_Euc.  Applying lem-hcb4-canonical-gram with n=1 yields (1-C_J e)||Z||<=||Z||_Euc<=(1+C_J e)||Z||.  Here C_J e<=1/4, so the two norms are equivalent.  Therefore every Euclidean-Cauchy sequence is inherited-norm Cauchy, converges in S_{P,Q} by the preceding closedness, and the upper comparison makes it converge Euclideanly; hence (S_{P,Q},||.||_Euc) is complete.
